searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md first and excluded everything already applied-to, screening, or rejected (Stripe x2, Tesla, Simon-Kucher, IMC Trading, Enova, Point72 x2/Cubist, Graviton, Figma, McMaster-Carr, McKinsey, Robert Half, Retell AI, Tuck Bridge, IBM x6, Ford, Red Ventures, MIT Future Fest, CIL, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, MLH, Adobe x3, LSEG, Robinhood, Mathematica, Veeva, Claude Corps, Capital One, CarMax, Micron, Kalshi, CSE Grader, MATS, Anthropic Fellows (July cohort), Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Disney, Horizon Fellowship, Notion BDR - ~40 rows). Checked data/applications.json in this repo too (empty, no additional exclusions). Graduation-date note: the task prompt described life/PROFILE.md as saying Aug 2026 default with the date 'genuinely unsettled' - that is stale. The file as it reads today says the opposite: 'Graduation: December 2026 - SETTLED by Dom 2026-08-04,' matching morning-briefing/profile.md. No live conflict; screened as December 2026 new-grad. Flagging the mismatch between the scheduled prompt's description and the file's current content so it can be corrected upstream. Network: confirmed the same restriction documented in hunt-results.json on 2026-10-24 through 2026-10-28 is still in effect today - WebFetch resolves anthropic.com (fetched https://www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs successfully: only Forward-Deployed Engineer/Staff FDE, Technical Deployment Lead, and research fellow/resident titles, none new-grad-labeled, FDE US openings are Staff-level only) but returns ENOTFOUND for job-boards.greenhouse.io, www.databricks.com, careers.microsoft.com, and www.startupschool.org - four more target-company/program domains tested this run, zero resolved, consistent with ~3.5 months of prior runs. Per the tool's own guidance, stopped after this pattern repeated rather than burning the fetch budget on hosts that will not resolve. Did not fall back to WebSearch-snippet-only inclusion per hunt.md's verification rule (a page must actually load to confirm it is open now and unmodified). Zero verified opportunities this run - not for lack of fit, but because the environment still cannot reach the job-board/ATS/program domains needed to verify eligibility and open status. This needs the session's network allowlist fixed (greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, and individual company career/program domains) before the hunt can surface anything again.
